newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-GRAF WINS FIRST SET IN OPEN FINAL AGAINST SELES.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF WINS FIRST SET IN OPEN FINAL AGAINST SELES.

text.p: Steffi Graf, gunning for her 21st career Grand Slam title, won a hotly contested first set in the U.S. Open final against arch-rival Monica Seles 7-5 at the National Tennis Centre on Sunday.

The top-seeded Graf, playing co-world number one Seles for the first time since beating her in last year's Open final, took the advantage early against the Yugoslav-born American with a service break in the third game for a 2-1 lead.
The set stayed on serve until the 10th game with Graf serving for the set at 5-4.

The German reached set point at 40-30 but Seles forced the game to deuce with a sizzling second-serve return. A forehand error gave Seles her first break point of the match and she cashed right in with an overhead winner set up by a poorly played drop shot from Graf.
Seles, whose service game throughout the tournament had been hampered by a shoulder injury, was putting her old time speed on her serves but that did not bother Graf.
Graf broke right back to take a 6-5 lead when a forehand cross court winner gave her a fourth break point in the 11th game and Seles finally capitulated with a backhand wide.
Graf served out the set at 30 when Seles returned her 99 mile per hour (160 kph) serve wide.
In the second set, Graf picked up right where she left off.
The German broke Seles in the first game, reaching break point at 30-40 with a backhand passing winner, and then seizing a 1-0 lead when Seles sailed a backhand way long.
Graf squelched any Seles chance of breaking right back by serving three aces in holding her next service game to lead 2-0.
Seles challenged Graf in the fourth game, extending the German to three deuces. But the 27-year-old Graf finally held her serve on her fourth game point with another ace.
The set stayed on serve without serious threat from that point on.
Graf clinched her fifth U.S. Open crown with a forehand cross court volley winner that clipped the net and then skipped into the open court.
The victory brought Graf her fifth U.S. Open title and 21st career Grand Slam crown.
